title: Longest Turbulent Subarray
summary: Given an integer array, identify the longest subarray where the comparison sign alternates between adjacent elements.
statement: Given an integer array, identify the longest subarray where the comparison sign alternates between adjacent elements. Specifically, for a subarray to be considered turbulent, it must alternate between greater than and less than comparisons at each step, depending on the index parity.
constraints: Adjacent comparisons must alternate strictly between greater and less.
Return the maximum contiguous turbulent length.
reference_solution:
def longest_turbulent_subarray(arr):
 up=down=best=1
 for a,b in zip(arr,arr[1:]):
  if a<b:up=down+1;down=1
  elif a>b:down=up+1;up=1
  else:up=down=1
  best=max(best,up,down)
 return best

Alternation forces the prior comparison direction, so these two suffix states are sufficient.
